name: Sally Lunn
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: good lively yeast
ingredients.originalText: half a cup of good lively yeast

instructions.text: Warm one-half cupful of butter in a pint of milk
Add a teaspoonful of salt and a tablespoonful of sugar
Add seven cupfuls of sifted flour
Beat thoroughly and when the mixture is blood warm, add four beaten eggs
Last of all, add half a cup of good lively yeast
Beat hard until the batter breaks in blisters
Set it to rise over night
In the morning, dissolve half a teaspoonful of soda and stir it into the batter
Turn it into a well-buttered, shallow dish to rise again about fifteen or twenty minutes
Bake about fifteen to twenty minutes
The cake should be torn apart, not cut

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Warm one-half cupful of butter in a pint of milk
2. Add a teaspoonful of salt and a tablespoonful of sugar
3. Add seven cupfuls of sifted flour
4. Beat thoroughly and when the mixture is blood warm, add four beaten eggs
5. Last of all, add half a cup of good lively yeast
6. Beat hard until the batter breaks in blisters
7. Set it to rise over night
8. In the morning, dissolve half a teaspoonful of soda and stir it into the batter
9. Turn it into a well-buttered, shallow dish to rise again about fifteen or twenty minutes
10. Bake about fifteen to twenty minutes
11. The cake should be torn apart, not cut
12. Bake a light brown
